usdRate.sourceName: BDCB Statistical Bulletin, table 6.2 Exchange Rates (BND per USD, end of period)
usdRate.note: The Brunei dollar is pegged 1:1 to the Singapore dollar.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Department of Economic Planning and Statistics (DEPS), CPI media release September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: CPI fell 0.1% year on year in September 2026 (August +0.5%).

inflation_projection.sourceName: 5-year CPI average (DEPS / Trading Economics); no inflation target under the currency board
inflation_projection.note: Brunei has no inflation target (BND pegged 1:1 to SGD) and CPI averaged about 1% over 2021-2025, so we plan with 1%.

policy_rate.sourceName: Brunei Darussalam Central Bank (BDCB) Statistical Bulletin, table 6.3 Overnight Standing Facilities Rates
policy_rate.note: Brunei runs a currency board (BND = SGD) and has no policy rate; this is the BDCB overnight Standing Facility Deposit Rate (lending rate 1.5%).

savings_account_rate.note: BDCB publishes no average savings rate; the only published savings rates found were individual banks' own rate pages, which we do not cite (ordinary savings pay roughly 0.1-0.2%).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: BDCB Statistical Bulletin, table 6.1 Average Deposit Rate 3 months

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: BDCB Statistical Bulletin, table 6.1 Average Deposit Rate 12 months

dps_rate.note: Searched bank and BDCB rate pages: no monthly recurring deposit scheme with a published rate is offered in Brunei.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 0.31% for 2025; BDCB's own average 3/6/12-month rates were 0.27%/0.37%/0.54% in June 2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Brunei has no government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals; only short-term government sukuk (up to 1 year) are issued.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: BDCB Statistical Bulletin, table 1.5.1 Sukuk Al-Ijarah yields, 3 months
tbill_91d_rate.note: Short-term government Sukuk Al-Ijarah, the Brunei equivalent of a treasury bill.

tbond_5y_rate.note: Brunei issues no government bonds beyond 1 year (BDCB table 1.5.1 lists 3-, 6-, 9- and 12-month sukuk only).

tbond_10y_rate.note: Brunei issues no government bonds beyond 1 year (BDCB table 1.5.1 lists 3-, 6-, 9- and 12-month sukuk only).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Brunei: taxes on personal income
tax_bank_interest.note: Brunei does not impose personal income tax on individuals, so bank interest is untaxed.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Brunei: taxes on personal income
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No personal income tax; any government security income of individuals is untaxed (no savings certificate exists).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: A deposit protection scheme exists (Deposit Protection Order 2010, Brunei Darussalam Deposit Protection Corporation) and the cover is widely reported as B$50,000 per depositor per member, but the BDPC website was unreachable (connection refused) and only a member bank's page showed the figure, so it is not cited.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: BDCB (then AMBD) Notice to Banks BU/N-12/2017/47 on Credit Cards, section 6.1
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Interest on credit cards may not exceed 1.5% per month on the outstanding amount (18% a year simple). Notice dates from 2017, older than 2025, and is still the rule BDCB publishes.

equity_return_low.sourceName: Global equity index in BND terms; BDCB safe rates
equity_return_low.note: Low case for a global index fund held in BND, allowing for a decade of weak returns and a firm BND (pegged to SGD).

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity index in BND terms; BDCB 12-month deposit rate 0.54% plus 4 points
equity_return_base.note: No local stock exchange: based on a global equity index in BND terms, capped at the 12-month deposit rate plus 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity index long-run record; BDCB safe rates
equity_return_high.note: High case near the long-run nominal return of a global index, less a little for BND strength against the US dollar.

gold_return_low.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; BND/USD history (BDCB table 6.2)
gold_return_low.note: Gold can go a decade without gains and the BND has tended to firm against the US dollar, so the low case is zero.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; BND/USD history (BDCB table 6.2)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 5% less roughly 1% a year of BND appreciation against the US dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; BND/USD history (BDCB table 6.2)
gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle in BND terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BDCB average deposit rates and sukuk yields
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case near the 3-month deposit rate (0.27%); no tax. Safe BND rates: 12-month deposit 0.535% (BDCB, Jun 2026), 1-year government sukuk 1.16%, 3-month 1.25% (Sep 2026); no personal income tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BDCB average deposit rates and sukuk yields
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case near the 12-month deposit rate (0.54%) that individuals can actually get. Safe BND rates: 12-month deposit 0.535% (BDCB, Jun 2026), 1-year government sukuk 1.16%, 3-month 1.25% (Sep 2026); no personal income tax.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BDCB average deposit rates and sukuk yields
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case at the current 3-month government sukuk yield (1.25%). Safe BND rates: 12-month deposit 0.535% (BDCB, Jun 2026), 1-year government sukuk 1.16%, 3-month 1.25% (Sep 2026); no personal income tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: BDCB publishes gross insurance/takaful claims and premiums (Statistical Bulletin tables 3.2-3.3) but no claim settlement ratio.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term takaful/life cover is sold (sum covered B$10,000 to B$1,000,000) but we found no published premium rates or regulator premium data.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Public hospital care is free or nominal for citizens; we found no published typical private hospital stay cost.

health_premium_table.note: No published private medical insurance premium rates or guides found for Brunei.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure, SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS)
oop_health_share.note: Figure refers to 2023, older than 2025; it is the latest available.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: DEPS CPI health sub-index (via Trading Economics: +0.8% y/y Sep 2026)
goal_inflation_health.note: Health CPI runs below 1%, but planning uses 2% to allow for private and overseas care costing more over time.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: DEPS CPI education sub-index (via Trading Economics: +0.3% y/y Sep 2026)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education CPI is near zero; 1.5% allows for private and overseas tuition rising faster than the subsidised public system.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)
life_expectancy.note: Men 73.5, women 77.7 (2024). Figure refers to 2024, older than 2025; it is the latest available.

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from expected age at death by current age; secondary source for UN WPP because the WHO GHO API was unavailable.

support_ratio.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant (via populationpyramid.net); World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 10.0 in 2025 (World Bank), 20.2 in 2040 and 42.3 in 2065 (UN WPP 2024). Figure refers to 2024, older than 2025; it is the latest available.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Tabung Amanah Pekerja (TAP), Skim Persaraan Kebangsaan FAQ
retirement_age_default.note: SPK annuity starts at 60; the Retirement Age Order 2010 set the minimum retirement age at 60 for men and women.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Global Voices report on the Sultan's decree raising the retirement age from 55 to 60
retirement_age_government.note: Secondary source (2009 report of the Sultan's decree raising the retirement age from 55 to 60); the Retirement Age Order 2010 applies age 60 across employment including the civil service. Figure dates from 2009, older than 2025; no later change found.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case near the 3-month deposit rate. Safe BND rates: 12-month deposit 0.535% (BDCB, Jun 2026), 1-year government sukuk 1.16%, 3-month 1.25% (Sep 2026); no personal income tax.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case near the 12-month deposit rate, below the 1-year government sukuk yield. Safe BND rates: 12-month deposit 0.535% (BDCB, Jun 2026), 1-year government sukuk 1.16%, 3-month 1.25% (Sep 2026); no personal income tax.

retirement_return_high.note: High case at the 3-month government sukuk yield. Safe BND rates: 12-month deposit 0.535% (BDCB, Jun 2026), 1-year government sukuk 1.16%, 3-month 1.25% (Sep 2026); no personal income tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of BND deposits and a global equity index
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: About 40% global equity at the low case and 60% deposits.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of BND deposits and a global equity index
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half global equity at 4.5% and half deposits at 0.6%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of BND deposits and a global equity index
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: About 60% global equity at the high case and 40% sukuk/deposits.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: ISSA country profile Brunei Darussalam 2022: Old-age pension (universal)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Universal flat B$250 a month from age 60 for citizens and stateless permanent residents with the residency qualification, adjusted ad hoc only (ISSA, policies as of 1 Jan 2022, older than 2025); no increase found for 2025-2026.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: ISSA country profile Brunei Darussalam 2022; Old Age and Disability Pensions Act amendment 2021
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Universal, non-contributory, from age 60 for citizens and stateless permanent residents with 10 years' residence before the claim (30 if born abroad); foreign-citizen PRs excluded since 1 Oct 2021. ISSA profile reflects policies as of 1 Jan 2022, older than 2025.

gratuity_rule.note: Brunei's Employment Order 2009 has no general statutory gratuity or end-of-service payment for private employees; retirement savings run through SPK.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Tabung Amanah Pekerja (TAP), Skim Persaraan Kebangsaan FAQ
public_pension_scheme.note: SPK (from 2023): employee 8.5% of basic salary to a Member Account, employer to a Retirement Account; lifetime inflation-adjusted annuity from 60, minimum B$250 a month for citizens; untaxed as Brunei has no personal income tax.

fdr_3m.note: Islamic banks call it term deposit (Deposit Berjangka).

fdr_1y.note: Banks do not offer BND fixed deposits beyond 12 months.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit scheme is offered.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond exists.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by BDCB; we found no channel for individuals to buy directly.

equity_fund.note: No local stock exchange; retail funds invest in foreign markets.

gold.note: Physical gold is freely bought from licensed goldsmiths.

insuranceRegulator.name: Brunei Darussalam Central Bank (BDCB), insurance and takaful supervision

pensionScheme.name: Tabung Amanah Pekerja (TAP), Skim Persaraan Kebangsaan (SPK)

oldAgeAllowance.name: Department of Community Development (JAPEM), Old Age Pension

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (free public healthcare for citizens)

statistics.name: Department of Economic Planning and Statistics (DEPS)
